name: site-clone-worker
description: Site Recreate clone engine. Local dev (Phase 2 CLI) resolves cheerio/sharp/playwright/firebase-admin from the repo root's node_modules — they are already root deps for other features (ai-seo-audit, GBP media, browserless/studio-render). This package.json exists so the standalone Cloud Run image (Phase 4) can npm install a self-contained node_modules matching those versions — see Dockerfile.
